title: 2. Install via npm (Recommended)
use_cases: Use when setting up the MCP server quickly without manual repository cloning
Configure when adding Firecrawl or LLM Knowledge Graph capabilities to Claude Code
Implement when deploying via npx to ensure automatic updates and dependency management
Configure when running the server from a local development path using Python
Implement when setting up authentication via environment variables or hidden key files
content:
**Easiest setup - no local paths needed:**

Add to your Claude Code MCP settings (`~/.claude/mcp_settings.json` or via Claude Code settings):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "firecrawl": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@mendable/firecrawl-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "FIRECRAWL_API_KEY": "your-firecrawl-api-key"
      }
    },
    "llm-kg": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@silkspace/llm-kg-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

- Get a free Firecrawl API key at [firecrawl.dev](https://firecrawl.dev)
- Python dependencies auto-install via postinstall hook (using uv or pip)

**Requirements:**

- Node.js 18+
- Python 3.10+
- `uv` (recommended) or `pip`

That's it! npx will download and run the MCP server automatically.

**Clone and install manually:**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/silkspace/llm-knowledge-graph.git
cd llm-knowledge-graph

# Install dependencies with uv
uv sync
```

**Then configure with local path:**

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "llm-kg": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["/path/to/llm-knowledge-graph/kg_mcp_server.py"]
    }
  }
}
```

Either set environment variable:

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your-api-key"
```

Or create file:

```bash
echo "your-api-key" > ~/.anthropic_api_key
```

```bash
source .venv/bin/act
